title: What the Grain Does Not Say

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The grain lies under wool and the figure comes to it on the tenth day. The figure knows what the wool covers. What the grain cost stays where no slate goes.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the rack end in Low Kiln, told in Smoke's last week

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and sixty-four to two hundred and sixty-six days, six months and eighty-four to six months and eighty-six days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound of crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; the covered grain handled for damp and rot piece by piece and still entered nowhere; the hand's answerings kept as honest objects and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage, and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question (T101 gains one further shaping only, a report of the question over the boards, and the askings still stand at five), no tenth record-first hand, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no name spoken over either sighting, no sale, no calling of the loan, no naming of a payer, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the covered grain or for the hand that did not come back, no silt-leach or cure named for the cold foot carried below the sill, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1, no third Account-day brought early, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fifth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated \daymark (Smoke 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813) and the chapter's only drop cap on the opening words: small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey at the hearth, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the cool stone at the rack end, the loaf shelf and the yard well. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on the hundred and second answer; set it down as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Carry the count from 263 to 264 exact, six months and eighty-four days, told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-four days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, the sour mineral Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. Three counts in three places — the kiln's four low pulls and silence under the floor, the river's water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — none rising into another, for agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T061/T082). Body inventory in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the severe face cold wears, knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse; he wants the crust lifted two inches. Both true, the second louder in a body of two hundred and sixty-four days, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the one grey streak shows pale, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing. At the loaf shelf her finger stays on top of the front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread; her lips move along a two-gapped row without giving either gap a figure; the pot rim is set out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T100, T058/T079). The dressed grain lies covered under wool on the cool stone at the rack end; she lifts a corner for damp and lays it back, changing nothing and gaining no figure (T077). The white that frost wrote on the well lip is grey now under the bucket and the yard calls the whole of it weather; he keeps whatever white was there on a place of its own with no cause, not a payer, not the widow's mark (a well is not an opening), not the first firing of Frost (T083/T085). A neighbour with a pot puts a cost-question to the pot and goes off level with nothing priced or entered; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and none is supplied (T015/T041/T047). No market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday; Smoke 30 (Day 269), the third and last reading of the second firing, stands five mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Hand answer one hundred and three: up an inch toward the low note, held for the small intake only, down on the river's next low note; the little silence after the count that ended in the room that does not touch is left empty again on its own place and not crossed, an object beside the held one and apart from it (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Names Not Spoken
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 264, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the drying racks and the space beneath the lowest rack, the pan's gone ring, the terrace and worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the edge of the Vail wheel-shed, the finger's-width-open back room as a direction and a sound only, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending, the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals; heat settles behind the pot and into the fold. One leathery brown-edged crust two inches off, its gap unnamed and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects and not in a story, his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-four days: the salt-stiff coat on its peg with the left-shoulder crease, the wheel-seat hollow on that side, the proverb gone years ago to a pot with no crack and said now over a corner where the repair was rubbed out, the debt against a firing of tiles circled without a name, neither paid nor settled nor done with. No collector came up the clay road on Smoke 25 and none went down it (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries the basket at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around seven things, each with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line, the finer grey hairline called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring with no scrape, crumb, print or word, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven in a row are seven and not an account, because an account wants a payer standing under it and none stands. That hand is carried and not named, not paid, not joined to the shelf's two gaps in the other room or to the one crust in the fold with its gap (T098 carried). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late and keeps the late because it puts off the paying, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, sets six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, and keeps Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the knife with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt. The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it comes to his teeth and goes as far as the word that would call the loan before stopping, a remembered ninth stopping and not a tenth before the seventh year at its very end, which has still not given; the Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent; his chest is tight as it has been since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring holding what light there is, and up in the Debt Loft, which reaches the boy only as a sound with a direction, the warm stone Sella gave him in the winter Garl died lies two years gone and cold in its unmarked clay pot, not tried and not forgiven (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra comes through with the day's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in the creases of a fist that had opened, and not bone-coloured slip; he parts dusty forearms from clean ones as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, asks neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate, speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), tells a pot You'll do, and withholds on the near-full tray beside the hearings the note he knows three turns ahead, with air under it and a want in it, advanced and not paid. Three or more unnamed men have gone low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him and no word that the room was cold; the room keeps its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices, which arrive at the basket as a direction. The burned-slate word stands at four from Slate Row, a direction over the boards and not a fifth telling; the two tellings of the counting room shut in the war stand at two and do not become three; three sayings about a pot stand with the premature Smoke 14 note on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause; the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn and he's not Vail stays sealed (T035/T031, T065/T095, T061/T082). When Sella's sentence goes low (The fire's low. It wants---) his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of it and holds until the end arrives at the pot; the boy reads one piece of iron with two bites, mercy and mutilation, with no Grathic word for both, joined to no kiln (T062). Under the roof she sets him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs and the one opening before Smoke 1 stays behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending or payer named, the next real opening standing far off in the first firing of Frost (T058/T079). In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers; three pot sayings with the premature note apart; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread under this roof; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes plus the loft scrape and the pale line of the carried man on five places and the held inch on a sixth, with its hundred and three answers; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her strip unread in her sleeve; the covered grain unfigured; the pan's ring, the shelf's two gaps and the fold's one crust on trays that do not touch; the ownerless question at five askings with no witness and no row named; and the house's not-doings on a place apart from his own kept gaps with a finger between and no joining (T080 held at nine, T101 held at five, T060/T086, T100). Hand answer one hundred and four: one rhythm carried across the little silence after a count that ended in the room that does not touch, taken as an object in its own right, crossing no second count and filling nothing to make a stroke in a row that had none, down on the river's next low note.

scenes.title: The Grain Under the Hand
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark: Day 265, Smoke 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813, from the small hours under the Vail roof up the Clay Yard to the drying racks, the rack end and the yard well, and back at the going of the light. New day, new date, no recap: 265 exact, six months and eighty-five days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-five days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1, because a yard, a rack, a well and a bed are not openings (T058/T079). Smoke 26 comes on its own morning, earned by that light, and was not brought into Day 264; no market, Cross or bell; Smoke 30 stands four mornings ahead and is not brought early. First smells and sounds as before: hot clay under tallow, wet wool, the sour Ash of the thaw, the kiln in fours with its gap, not a bell. Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, thaw told to the coals, broken pot turning them, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches out, fold put right without a look at his face, thread left frozen. The chapter's domestic change, advanced and not paid: on the cool stone at the rack end she draws the wool wholly back from the dressed grain for the last time before the third reading and turns the grain over in the flat of her hand, piece by piece, feeling for damp and rot and setting each piece down where it lay, then lays the wool back and carries the dish away from the hearth. She gives no figure, speaks no number over it and enters nothing; the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 will still not know what it cost, and the space between the figure and its price stays unsigned (T077, T015/T041/T047). The boy reads the handling as a surgeon turns a wound to see the part that was hidden, and keeps the finding — that a thing can be examined closely and still enter nothing — on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, a grievance or a doctrine, and does not lay it across the house's other not-doings or across his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stands (T071/T072, T061/T082). At the yard well Ilva is glimpsed once, drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb. Asked what the firings of Smoke have cost, her hand stays in her sleeve; the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter's cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the charcoal under the shelf or any other private keeping. Her eyes go to the asker and her mouth answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She goes on with her water and nobody turns twice. No tenth record-first hand is filed; the ninth stays on its own tray with a finger between it and the eighth (T080 held at nine, not paid). A neighbour with a pot puts a cost-question to the pot and goes off level; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and none is supplied. Hand answer one hundred and five: up an inch toward the low note, held through one whole interval of the river's own going, down on the river's next low note, borrowing no house count and no stroke.

scenes.title: A Saying About an Asking
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 265, no new dated heading: afternoon thinning into the small hours at the walked-around places, the yard well, the boards, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed and the towel. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong. Heat draws back from the fold into the pot; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform. The seven walked-around places are gone around again with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Below the sill a child's foot that stayed cold after the flood is wrapped in a woman's wool and called the cold by her and weather by the yard; the boy keeps it as the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting beyond, and names no cause, no silt-leach and no cure, because there is no Grathic word for it and nobody in the yard has asked for one (T093/T094 carried, not paid). A wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it — a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not joined to the man carried out on Day 188, to any pot saying or to the pale line kept on its own place (T064). Mid-afternoon, over the boards and not to the basket, a voice with no owner, no room, no hand at the kiln and no cause says the row question again in a new form: not a fresh asking but a report of one, somebody asking which row it was that went quiet. The weather answers first and the price of barley after it, the voice goes off up the terrace and the row stands where it stood with nobody leaning in to take an answer down. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and sets this further shaping on the seventh place beside the five askings with a finger between each pair. T101 is advanced and not paid: the askings still stand at five, no sixth asking came, no witness stands anywhere to be asked, no row is named, and the shaping is not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a fifth telling of the burned slate (still four), not a third telling of the shut counting room (still two), not a fourth likeness of the pot saying (still three with the Smoke 14 note apart), not a cause, not a name and not a payment (T101, T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082). At the kindling Tarn's knife lies at the very lip with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, the unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence is brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and not trying not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra's meal-fine dust, his bent finger standing in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the pot's full note known and withheld, he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven go as before, and the men in the back room are given no name (T035/T031, T062). In the small hours the file is turned out and checked and found exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh; three near-full answers and three pot sayings on separate places; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes on three places plus the loft scrape and the pale line on two more and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with the ninth on its own tray and the strip unread; the new shaping of the row question held apart from the five askings with no witness; the house's not-doings on a place apart from his own kept gaps with a finger between (T080 held at nine, T101 advanced and unpaid). Hand answer one hundred and six: one rhythm for the small intake let go, then a second rhythm carried across the little silence after a count that ended in the other room, the two intervals laid apart and not across one another, the empty silence kept empty on its own place, down on the river's next low note.

scenes.title: The Last Morning of the Week
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark: Day 266, Smoke 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813, the small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the drying racks, the rack end, the loaf shelf, the boards and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: 266 exact, six months and eighty-six days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-six days, its payer unnamed (T088); the widow's mark hanging where it hangs, untouched at a shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, afternoon and dusk (T058/T079). The third working week goes out as it came in, an ordinary tending that has learned nothing from the second reading, and the nothing learned is kept as a finding with no payer (T077, T071/T072). Smoke 30 (Day 269), the third and last Account-day and market of the second firing, stands three mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; the first firing of Frost (Day 271) is far off and unbrought; no market, Cross or bell. Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row without giving either gap a figure, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing (T100). The dressed grain is turned under the wool for damp and laid back on the cool stone at the rack end, changed in state and given no figure; she does not handle it again as she did the day before, and the arithmetic to be read over it on Smoke 30 will not know its cost, the space between the figure and its price still unsigned (T077). Frost has gone out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard calls it weather. A wrong wind off High Kiln brings the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a cause (T064). Costs asked at the door and the well go to the pot and the weather; a fist comes up toward the well, is looked at and goes back into a sleeve, so no figure arrives and none is supplied (T015/T041/T047, T077). At the kindling the knife is at the lip with six where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot; Six counted. The next I don't count; the ear-sentence brought to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, with no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076). At the wheel-shed Jorra's grey dust and his finger in the damper go as before and the men are given no name (T035/T031, T062). Hand answer one hundred and seven: up an inch toward the low note and down before the letting-go of a borrowed count from the room that does not touch, borrowing no stroke and filling nothing to make a row come out even; the little silence after that count is left on its own place, whole and uncrossed (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Hand Goes On Past the Note
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 266, Smoke 27, Seventhday, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed, the boards and the towel. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong. Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; one leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, a keeping and not a story, his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-six days, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 25, 26 or 27 (T009/T013/T092). The seven walked-around places are gone around with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T098 carried). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven places, sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts under her breath toward no opening and goes to her own bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, afternoon, dusk or going of the light on Smoke 25, 26 or 27, because a bed, a basket and a dusk are not openings; the one opening before Smoke 1 stays behind the household with no lesson, mending, sign or payer named, and the next real opening stands far off in the first firing of Frost (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the stone cold in its loft pot and not trying not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra's dust, his bent finger in the damper, the burned slate at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart and no fourth likeness made a cause, the row question with its five askings and one further shaping but no witness and no row named, the promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed (T035/T031, T062, T065/T095, T101, T061/T082). In the small hours he turns the file out on the towel and finds the whole of it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place; three near-full answers; three pot sayings with the premature note apart; four low things with water over water a fifth; told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke's second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread under this roof; nine stoppings with no tenth; three held changes on three places, the loft scrape on a fourth and the pale line of the carried man on a fifth, and the held inch on a sixth; nine record-first hands with Ilva's ninth on its own tray and her strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the covered grain handled the day before and covered again, still unfigured, the space between its figure and its price unsigned; the pan's gone ring, the shelf's two gaps and the fold's one crust with its gap on trays that do not touch; the row question at five askings with one further shaping, no witness and no row named; and the house's not-doings kept beside his own kept gaps with a finger between and no joining (T080 held at nine, T101 advanced and unpaid, T060/T086, T100, T077). The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid, comes on the last answer: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, holds for the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of the breaths Sella counts in the room that does not touch, does not come down with her breath, keeps the small height through the little silence after her count has ended, and goes on past the river's next low note to come down on the one after it — holding across two of the river's intervals with no second house count borrowed for the second. The house's count is kept on its own place, the river's two notes on another, and the little silence between is kept empty on a third, with no stroke supplied to agree any two, for agreeing would want a payer and none stands (T071/T072, T061/T082). It is one hundred and eight, filed on the sixth place beside one hundred and seven with no payer named, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: an honest coordination and not a longer reach, a hearing, a seventh of the full note, a stopping, a payment, one of the held changes, a key, a power or a rule. Two hundred and sixty-six stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath; six months and eighty-six days are told by nobody; one hundred and two answers became one hundred and eight and none is a reach; the carried fire stops at four with its fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-six days and its payer unnamed; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs; the grain lies covered and unfigured; the seventh year stands at its very end and has still not given. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn; Smoke 30 stands three mornings ahead and is not reached for; the first firing of Frost stands far off and unbrought. The hand lies back against the fold as a tool put away; the file lies open with every tray parted and every gap left gap; the count goes forward into Smoke 28, a day that has not earned its heading. Not mid-action; a placing-down, forward, unresolved.
